FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
CIRCULAR
Date: 29-07-2020
NEW FACILITIES ADDED IN ONLINE MENTIONING PLATFORM
In view of the increase in the number of matters being received for
mentioning through the Online Mentioning Platform, Honourable the Chief
Justice has been pleased to approve the following additional features in the
platform:
(i) Serial Number will be allotted to the mentioning request received
online and the same will be sent through SMS to the advocate
applying for mentioning, immediately after receipt of the online
mentioning request.
(ii) This serial number will be in separate series for Civil and Criminal
matters and would be identical to that in the list of mentioning
matters to be placed before the Honourable Judge designated to
take up mentioning matters.
(iii) The matters in the Civil and Criminal mentioning list being so
placed, will be in the order of this mentioning request serial
number. Thus, the matters in the list will be in the order of the
time when the request was received on the portal.
These additional features will bring about convenience for the
Honourable Judges as well as the advocates, who can refer to their serial
number before the Honourable Judge, on joining the Video Conferencing for
mentioning of the matter.
The aforesaid new features are being implemented in the Online
Mentioning Platform, starting from tomorrow i.e. 30/07/2020.
REGISTRAR GENERAL
